verdict.rationale: Notte docs describe a vault concept where credentials are encrypted and the LLM never sees actual credentials, plus persistent cookies/login state and verified emails/phone numbers for sign-up and 2FA. However, there is no explicit walkthrough of a TOTP-based 2FA challenge being solved end-to-end, and no independent/hands-on confirmation that login+2FA flows work reliably in practice. missing for 10: explicit TOTP/2FA workflow example, independent verification of successful login automation with secrets hidden from the model.
